title: Dolayli Anlatim (Reported Speech)
description_tr: Reported Speech (dolayli anlatim), birinin soylediklerini kendi cumlelerimizle aktarmaktir. Direkt konusma tirnakla verilir: He said, 'I am sick.' Dolayli anlatimda tirnak kalkar ve zaman bir adim geriye kayar (tense backshift): He said that he was sick. Sinavlarda en cok zaman kaydirmasi ve zaman/yer zarflarinin degisimi sorulur.
turkish_logic: Turkce'de dolayli anlatim '-digi/-ecegi/-ip/-madigini' gibi eklerle yapilir: 'Hasta oldugunu soyledi.' Ingilizce'de ise fiil zamani bir adim geri kaydirilir: 'am/is → was', 'will → would', 'can → could'. Turkce'de zaman kaymasi bu kadar belirgin degildir, bu yuzden Ingilizce'deki backshift kuralini ozellikle calismaniz gerekir.
key_rules: Present Simple (V1/Vs) → Past Simple (V2): 'I feel sick' → He said he felt sick.
Present Continuous (am/is/are + Ving) → Past Continuous (was/were + Ving): 'I am waiting' → She said she was waiting.
Present Perfect (have/has + V3) → Past Perfect (had + V3): 'I have finished' → He said he had finished.
Past Simple (V2) → Past Perfect (had + V3): 'I took the medicine' → She said she had taken the medicine.
Will → Would: 'I will come' → He said he would come.
Can → Could: 'I can help' → She said she could help.
May → Might: 'I may be late' → He said he might be late.
Must → Had to: 'I must go' → She said she had to go.

ZAMAN/YER ZARFI DEGISIMLERI: today → that day, yesterday → the day before / the previous day, tomorrow → the next day / the following day, now → then, here → there, this → that, these → those, ago → before/earlier, last week → the week before / the previous week, next week → the following week.
SAID vs TOLD: 'said' tek basina kullanilir (He said that...). 'told' mutlaka nesne alir (He told ME that...). 'He told that...' YANLIS!
SORU AKTARIMI: Yes/No soru → if/whether + duz cumle sirasi. 'Are you okay?' → He asked if I was okay. Wh- soru → Wh- + duz cumle sirasi. 'Where is the pharmacy?' → She asked where the pharmacy was.

examples.en: Direct: 'I have a headache.' → Reported: The patient said that he had a headache.
examples.tr: Direkt: 'Basim agriyor.' → Dolayli: Hasta basinin agridigini soyledi.
examples.why: Present Simple 'have' → Past Simple 'had'. Tense backshift bir adim geri. 'I' → 'he' zamir degisimi de yapildi.

examples.en: Direct: 'I will prescribe antibiotics.' → Reported: The doctor said that he would prescribe antibiotics.
examples.tr: Direkt: 'Antibiyotik yazacagim.' → Dolayli: Doktor antibiyotik yazacagini soyledi.
examples.why: 'will' → 'would' olarak kaydiriliyor. 'I' → 'he' zamir degisimi. Future tense'in backshift hali.

examples.en: Direct: 'Are you taking any medication?' → Reported: The doctor asked if I was taking any medication.
examples.tr: Direkt: 'Herhangi bir ilac kullaniyor musunuz?' → Dolayli: Doktor ilac kullanip kullanmadigimi sordu.
examples.why: Yes/No sorusu oldugu icin 'if' kullaniliyor. 'are you taking' → 'I was taking' (backshift + zamir degisimi). Soru isareti kalkar, duz cumle sirasi olur.

examples.en: Direct: 'I took the medicine yesterday.' → Reported: She said that she had taken the medicine the day before.
examples.tr: Direkt: 'Ilaci dun ictim.' → Dolayli: Ilaci bir gun once ictigini soyledi.
examples.why: Past Simple 'took' → Past Perfect 'had taken'. 'yesterday' → 'the day before'. Hem zaman hem zarf degisimi yapildi.

examples.en: Direct: 'Where does it hurt?' → Reported: The doctor asked where it hurt.
examples.tr: Direkt: 'Neresi agriyor?' → Dolayli: Doktor neresinin agridigini sordu.
examples.why: Wh- sorusu: 'Where' kalir ama soru sirasi duz cumle sirasina donusur. 'does it hurt' → 'it hurt' (backshift + yardimci fiil duser).

tips: Altin kural: Reporting verb (said/told) gecmis zamanday sa, aktarilan cumle bir adim geri kayar. Reporting verb simdiki zamandaysa (He says...) backshift GEREKMEZ.
'Said' nesne almaz, 'told' nesne ALIR. 'He said me' YANLIS. 'He told me' DOGRU. 'He said to me' DOGRU (to ile).
Soru aktariminda soru sirasi KALKAR! 'Where is he?' → 'She asked where he was.' NOT 'She asked where was he.' Duz cumle sirasi kullanilir.
Past Perfect daha geriye gidemez! 'I had already eaten' → He said he had already eaten (degismez). Had + V3 oldugu gibi kalir.
'Must' iki sekilde aktarilir: Zorunluluk ise → 'had to'. Tahmin ise → 'must' kalir. 'You must rest' → said I had to rest. 'He must be tired' → said he must be tired.
Sinav taktigi: Once direkt cumledeki zamani belirle, sonra tablodan bir adim geri kaydir. Zarflari (today, here, this) degistirmeyi unutma!
'That' zorunlu degil, dusurulur: 'He said he was tired' = 'He said that he was tired'. Ama sinavda 'that' olan secenegi tercih et, daha net.
